title: Visual Review
description: Evidence-based review of one render (production/issues/<ISS_ID>/pages/<PG_ID>/reviews/<RENDER_ID>.review.yaml, or production/issues/<ISS_ID>/cover/reviews/<RENDER_ID>.review.yaml for a cover): fourteen named checks with pixel evidence, findings with expected / visible / repair / recheck, two gates, and a verdict. A finding may also be a person's change request (source: user_request), and a review opened by such a request records its checks and gates as not_performed until a reviewer fills them in. validate-workspace.js enforces the review rules.

page.description: Page under review. A cover review names the cover ID here (CV_001).

render.description: The render under review: a page render or a cover render.

supersedes.description: The render this one replaces, or null.

independent.description: true = the reviewer did not generate the image.

compared_against.description: What the pixels were compared to.

references.description: Reference assets the pixels were compared to.

neighbors.description: Renders of neighboring pages that were opened alongside.

checks.description: Every check, each with a result and evidence that describes pixels, not the prompt.

style_fidelity.description: Does the render match the look master and the style bible? not_performed: nobody has judged it yet (a review opened by a change request).

narrative_continuity.description: Do identity, position, custody, state, and causality hold? not_performed: nobody has judged it yet.

verdict.description: pass: no findings. fixed: findings repaired and rechecked. flagged: a blocking finding is open, a gate fails, a person's change request is open, or a check or gate has not been performed.

repair_cycle.description: 0 for a first render; +1 per repair. Never exceeds project.repair_policy.max_cycles.

human_approval.description: Human approval, recorded apart from the verdict.

status.description: Human decision, separate from the verdict.

notes.description: Free-form notes for people. Never read by scripts.

result.description: Outcome of the check. not_performed: nobody has judged it yet, which only a review opened by a change request records; such a review stays flagged.

evidence.description: What is visible in the render that supports the result. For not_performed, why the check was not made.

finding.description: One defect with its evidence and repair, or one change a person asked for. A reviewer's finding names its check; a user request may leave it out.

id.description: Finding ID, unique within the review, e.g. F01.

panel.description: Panel ID, or null for a page-level finding.

check.description: The check the finding belongs to. Required unless source is user_request.

source.description: Who raised the finding. reviewer (the default when the field is absent): the review found it in the pixels. user_request: a person asked for the change.

region.description: The area the finding is about, in fractions of the page (0 to 1) measured from its top-left corner. x + w and y + h do not exceed 1.

expected.description: What canon or the plan calls for.

visible.description: Pixel-based observation of what the render shows.

severity.description: blocking: identity ambiguity, duplicates, impossible positions, broken causality, missing critical state transitions.

status.description: open: unresolved. fixed: repaired and rechecked. accepted: a minor defect left as is.

recheck.description: Recheck of the repair. Required when status is fixed.

render.description: The corrected render that was reopened.

evidence.description: What is visible in the corrected render.
